Classes

SCHEDULE

No pre-regristration required. A beginner class is required of everyone in order to meet class standards and curriculum.

Try a Class

Please arrive 5 minutes before class starts to fill out new member paperwork. Contact us by email or phone for a recommended class.

*Intermediate class requires gloves, shin guards and coach permission. **Fighter training and advanced drilling require coach permission. ***No unsupervised sparring without coach approval. ****Open gym during all class times.
